verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs say Storage can optimize and resize images on the fly. Any image in a bucket can be transformed via transform options on signed or public URLs, with client-library support, so no self-run image pipeline is needed. The feature is gated to the Pro Plan and above, and the evidence describes it only briefly. Missing for 10: detail on which transformations are supported (formats, quality, crop modes), availability on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
